title: Skill Question Registry (questions.yaml)
description: Schema for a subskill's canonical question + axis registry (skills/<skill>/questions.yaml), the single source of truth consumed by _skills_common/evidence_graph.build_evidence_graph for the question<->card<->literature-axis crosswalk. VERDICT-INERT and display-only: nothing here feeds a rule, resolver, or gate. Each question's `measurement_types` is the card-join key (a card joins a question when its card-contract measurement_type is in this list) and MUST resolve to a real card measurement_type (enforced by validators/validate_questions.py, which JSON Schema cannot express). `axis_id` is the unified claim/literature axis shared with the skill's narrator lens so the axis->question crosswalk resolves.

axis_vocabulary.description: axis_id -> human label; the axis letters the narrator lens uses.

id.description: Stable semantic slug — the join key every graph edge references (NOT the positional Q1..Qn).

legacy_id.description: The positional id the skill's question_table emits (Q1..Qn), for joining onto the emitted headline.question_table.

axis_id.description: Unified claim/literature axis; null = no axis.

subtype.description: True when this question anchors the --subtypes-gated by-subtype panorama (disambiguates a measurement_type shared by a whole-cohort + by-subtype card pair).

measurement_types.description: The card-join key. MAY be empty for a corroboration/display_only question that summarizes rather than joining cards by measurement_type. Every non-empty entry MUST be the measurement_type of at least one real card contract (validate_questions.py cross-checks against cards/).
